verdict.rationale: Formant documents first-party teleoperation over a real-time, low-latency, peer-to-peer WebRTC connection between the device and its web app. Operators can control the robot from anywhere via joystick, buttons or custom configurable teleop interfaces, and can send commands during teleop sessions. A durable message queue and low-bandwidth agent modes add some evidence of resilience on constrained networks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of live video streaming during teleop (only time-synced video records are mentioned), concrete latency or network-degradation handling for the teleop stream itself, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
